❌ **Invalid Usage**

**Correct Format:**
`.slowmode <time>` or `/slowmode duration:<time>`

**Examples:**
🕐 `.slowmode 5s` — 5 seconds
🕐 `.slowmode 30s` — 30 seconds
🕐 `.slowmode 1m` — 1 minute
🕐 `.slowmode 5m` — 5 minutes
🕐 `.slowmode 2h` — 2 hours
🛑 `.slowmode off` — disable

💡 **Tip:** Use `/slowmode` for an interactive experience!
